title: `_pass_exact_filters` has cyclomatic complexity 32 (threshold: 15)
detail: Lizard reports CCN=32 for `_pass_exact_filters` (52 lines). A function with 32 independent paths is extremely difficult to test exhaustively; statistically most branches will never be covered. The function is a dispatch on filter key names with many `if/elif` chains. Suggested fix: extract per-key filter helpers and dispatch through a registry or dictionary.

title: `get_by_filters` has cyclomatic complexity 19 (threshold: 15)
detail: Lizard reports CCN=19 for `get_by_filters` (55 lines, 22 local variables). The function combines pagination logic, filter dispatch, and result assembly in a single method body. Suggested fix: extract the pagination helper and the per-filter dispatch into separate methods.
